question: What claim is made about who told the teaching of the Mothers and to whom?
premises: The teaching of the Mothers was told again.
It was told by the sky-movers.
It is addressed to the goddess and beloved one.
inference: Again, the sky-movers told the teaching of the Mothers, O goddess and beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given here.
plain_english: Again, O goddess and beloved one, the teaching of the Mothers was told by the sky-movers.
